about.en: MUSHROOM (SHROOM) is the fixed-supply, fair-launch token of Shroom Network, a liquidity network that pairs SHROOM with stock tokens on Robinhood Chain and uses protocol-owned liquidity fees for buybacks. It is an ERC-20 on Robinhood Chain at 0xab093def657f15df31b33922a95e047add645b29, launched through the Pons launchpad. It is unrelated to other tokens using the SHROOM ticker, such as Shroomates on Solana and Niftyx Protocol on Ethereum.
